# Every recipe that makes the chosen good, best output first, minus the
# ones wtp_offer turns away. Scope: country
wtp_collect_recipes = {
	clear_global_variable_list = wtp_shown_recipes
	set_variable = { name = wtp_recipe_count value = 0 }

	if = { limit = { global_var:wtp_good = goods:beer }
		wtp_offer = { m = brewery_mill_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = brewery_manufactory_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = bavarian_beer_workshop_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = bavarian_brewery_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = fruit_beer_workshop_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = honey_beer_workshop_maintenance }

		wtp_offer = { m = millet_beer_workshop_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = rice_beer_workshop_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = wheat_beer_workshop_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = fruit_brewery_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = honey_brewery_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = maize_brewery_maintenance }
		wtp_offer = { m = millet_brewery_maintenance }

		wtp_offer = { m = rural_millet_brewery }

	else_if = { limit = { global_var:wtp_good = goods:books }
		wtp_offer = { m = printing_mill_maintenance }
